scoring_notes: Quality (0.45) and Durability (0.45) dominate — body material and cartridge technology are THE scoring differentiators per StarCraft teardowns. Performance flat at 0.10 because all faucets deliver water — spray technology and flow rate create minimal differentiation.

calibration_products.name: California Faucets
calibration_products.rationale: Flühs (Germany) + Kerox (Hungary) cartridges — best combined cartridge sourcing. PVD lifetime finish. Solid brass cast body. US-made Huntington Beach CA. StarCraft near-perfect rating. Lifetime PVD warranty. Parts excellent. The professional benchmark.

calibration_products.name: In2aqua
calibration_products.rationale: Kerox PVD+ cartridge at 4M cycles — highest documented cycle rating in residential. Best warranty per StarCraft analysis. Solid brass construction. German-engineered. Lifetime warranty. Parts good but not as widely stocked as US brands.

calibration_products.name: Waterstone
calibration_products.rationale: 316 stainless steel bar stock body — best body material in residential faucets. True manufacturer (machined, not cast). Murrieta CA. BUT: Geann (Taiwan) cartridges at 500K cycles (lower than Flühs/Kerox). No PVD finish (powder coat instead). Body quality pulls it up, cartridge/finish pull it down.

calibration_products.name: Brizo (DST Cartridge Lines)
calibration_products.rationale: Diamond Seal Technology (DST) cartridge at 5M cycles — highest cycle count but proprietary (not Flühs/Kerox). Brilliance PVD finish. Solid brass body. BUT: >2/3 China manufacturing, plastic spray wands, not all Brizo models use DST (some Sedal/unknown). Must specify -DST suffix models.

calibration_products.name: Delta Mid-Range (DST models)
calibration_products.rationale: Same DST 5M-cycle tech as Brizo on -DST suffix models. ZAMAK (zinc alloy) shell + PEX waterway instead of solid brass (-1 dock from Brizo). Chrome finish (no PVD). Massive parts availability — every hardware store. Lifetime warranty. Must specify -DST models.

calibration_products.name: Kraus
calibration_products.rationale: Marketeer model — does not manufacture. Claims solid brass but unknown cartridge supplier (mixed/generic Chinese). Chrome-only finish. Source traceability unknown. Limited parts availability. StarCraft rates low. Plumbers and pros warn about Kingston Brass/Kraus tier — premium-looking but ZAMAK/plastic inside. Lifetime warranty on paper but execution questioned.

platform_disclosures: Delta Faucet Company (Masco): Delta, Brizo, Peerless share DST cartridge technology. Brizo = brass body + PVD. Delta = ZAMAK + chrome. Peerless = cheapest finish/materials. Same core engineering, different build quality.
Fortune Brands Innovations (FBIN): Moen, Rohl, Perrin & Rowe, Riobel, Shaws — potential cartridge/component sharing within House of Rohl. Moen cartridge in Rohl needs confirmation.
Kohler Co: Kohler, Kallista (luxury), Sterling (value) — component sharing likely but factory differentiation unclear.
